domain: iam / workload PDP / k8s tenant quota authz

facets.F1_correctness: Adds a structured ResourceCondition::SameTenantAsPrincipal that compiles to a Cedar request-time principal.tenant_id == resource.tenant_id clause while preserving resource type matching.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 unit tests cover resource attributes, same-tenant allow, cross-tenant deny, missing resource tenant fail-closed, and default tenant-quota PDP read/write cross-tenant denies.
facets.F3_maintainability: The DSL extension is a single enum variant plus resource attributes on the existing domain Resource type; tenant-quota default policies reuse a local default_quota_policies helper.
facets.F4_compatibility: Existing Resource::new callers continue to build resources with empty attributes; no dependency, BUCK target, generated face, workflow, API route, or Cargo manifest changes.
facets.F5_security: Moves the same-tenant invariant into PDP policy evaluation so scope-only tenant principals cannot authorize another tenant quota if adapter guard code is bypassed.
facets.F6_privacy: Prevents tenant quota records from being read by another tenant through the PDP policy path.
facets.F7_operability: Authorization failure behavior remains default-deny/Denied with existing adapter errors; no runtime configuration is required.
facets.F8_performance: Adds a small Cedar attribute comparison and one resource attribute projection per request; no network, storage, or provider call is introduced.
facets.F9_compliance: No hand-edited *.generated.json files and no new dependencies. Evidence is append-only and Buck2 is the verification authority.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of three Rust files plus append-only evidence/audit rows.
facets.F11_observability: Decision reasons and adapter errors remain on existing paths; this slice adds tests rather than new telemetry schema.
facets.F13_migration: Retains the #872 imperative guard as defense-in-depth while migrating the invariant into provider-neutral Cedar/PDP policy.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected a full PDP rewrite because the acceptance criteria can be met by a minimal structured DSL condition and typed resource attributes.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: This closes issue #879 without touching generated faces, broad markdown-retirement buckets, workflows, or shared provider adapter surfaces.

comparable_surfaces: AWS IAM condition keys comparing principal and resource tenant/account tags
GCP IAM Conditions restricting project or resource ownership
Kubernetes admission/RBAC layers that require namespace or tenant equality before quota mutation

hyperscaler_lens.provider_neutrality: Uses the existing Cedar engine and Oyatie workload-domain types; no cloud SDK, shell wrapper, or provider dependency is added.
